annotations.title: Analyze classical Yogas: formation, strength, cancellation and timing

description: YOGAS. Evaluates about a hundred classical yogas — the 32 Nabhasa yogas, Pancha Mahapurusha, Chandra and Surya yogas, Raja and Dhana yogas, named Viparita and Parivartana types, Neecha Bhanga, Lakshmi/Saraswati/Parvata and traditional afflictions — with rule, evidence, cancellation tests, a participant-strength grade and the dasha periods that activate each formed yoga.

asOfIso.description: ISO date-time for the dasha activation windows; defaults to now

place.description: Catalogue query or display label when explicit coordinates are supplied

time.description: Local birth time HH:MM (24-hour); 6:30 PM is also accepted

timezone.description: Required IANA timezone when explicit coordinates are supplied, for example Asia/Kolkata

timezoneOffset.description: Optional fallback offset; derived from timezone and the requested local date when omitted
